description.value: Blacksmith Bakery is an artisan bakery and licensed café-bistro chain founded in 2014 by Chef Stephan Schigas, whose career included heading the pastry kitchen at London's Michelin-starred Zafferano. The original Fort Langley location occupies the historic site of Reid's Blacksmith Shop (circa 1910), giving the brand its name and a strong sense of local character. With four locations across Fort Langley, Langley, and Maple Ridge, it offers European-style pastries, brunch, and bistro fare — a solid food stop for cyclists moving through the Fraser Valley.
